_comment: OpenAI price table, USD per 1,000,000 tokens. Pinned from https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing and per-model pages. See '_retrieved'. 'in'=uncached input, 'cached_in'=cached input, 'out'=output (reasoning tokens are billed as output). 'batch_*' are the Batch API (async, ~50% discount) rates.
